images.title: Radcliffe Camera, Oxford
images.creator: Lies Thru a Lens 
images.alt: Oxford's Radcliffe Camera centred between college buildings in Radcliffe Square.
images.caption: The Radcliffe Camera in Oxford. Oxford leads PrepSavvy's philosophy journal research index.
images.credit: Photo: Lies Thru a Lens  / Wikimedia Commons / CC BY 2.0.
images.crop_suggestion: For a 16:9 hero, remove foreground paving while retaining the complete dome. Label any applied crop in the image credit.
images.license_note: Commons records a Flickr license review on 2013-05-24 and notes that the photographer later changed the Flickr licensing; Commons retains the earlier CC license record.

images.title: Humanities Gateway at UC Irvine

images.alt: Students walking outside the curved Humanities Gateway building at UC Irvine.
images.caption: Humanities Gateway at UC Irvine, photographed in April 2025.
images.credit: Photo: SinisterLizard / Wikimedia Commons / CC BY-SA 4.0.

images.recommended_use: Alternative hero if the lead visual should represent philosophy rather than a single university
images.title: The School of Athens
images.creator: Raphael
images.license: Public domain; faithful reproduction of a public-domain two-dimensional artwork
images.alt: Raphael's School of Athens, with Plato and Aristotle surrounded by philosophers beneath vaulted arches.
images.caption: Raphael's The School of Athens, 1509–1511.
images.credit: Raphael, The School of Athens / Wikimedia Commons / public domain.
images.crop_suggestion: A horizontal central crop can retain Plato, Aristotle and the surrounding debate. Keep the artwork's identity in the caption.
images.license_note: Commons identifies this file with the Public Domain Mark. Credit is supplied for provenance.
